name: LiFx ClientAutoloader
description: Client-side mod framework for Life is Feudal: Your Own: discovers and loads client mods, fires client hooks, provides autojoin, an in-game knowledge base key, a version overlay, file-hash verification and a bundled JSON library.
loadOrderNote: Framework-adjacent: this is the client-side framework itself, so its payload must be in place before any client mod that registers against the LiFx client hooks.
